title: Indonesia ADM2: qualify and deliver the complete three-package source session

labels.name: type:engineering
labels.description: Application, database, geography releases and infrastructure

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Reviewed scope and dependencies ready for a worker claim

body:
Parent: #1202.

Complete the gb-IDN-ADM2 source-family session as one coordinated work item. Its exact scope is the three packages listed in the contract and the 344 stable target IDs in evidence_quality.subject_ids. Owner indices are joined to lineage.locations[index].id; they are not stable IDs. The complete source roster and required IDN/MYS/PNG/TLS competitors remain part of qualification.

Acceptance:

1. Preserve the queue's frozen a61b6f9e7f88b1da380e3a834f89d7509132ed71 provenance and original source bytes. Bind the exact package selectors, owner/source joins and source vintages. For each current candidate interval, record already-owned, supported addition, supported exclusion or an explicit held mapping/topology/physical/conflict outcome with evidence and next action. Check that interval dispositions cover the complete scoped packages without duplication.
2. Before proposing additions, subtract current selected ownership and authenticate current owner-zero, stable target identity, source-to-location authority, territorial exclusions and relevant source competitors. A lineage match or physical-mask disagreement alone is insufficient. Preserve occupied cells and existing river/location water ownership. Deliver only positive, source-qualified native additions through the existing source-target constructor; retain aggregates and unresolved candidates separately when the accepted reader cannot admit them.
3. For every delivered subset, bind actual immutable inputs/results and metrics in the existing scientific manifest, use fresh owned output vintages, verify selected-native conservation and witnesses, and validate the actual emitted package/consumer. Preserve all prior cumulative patch and ledger rows. Reuse accepted unchanged methods and actual reader roles. Append only consumed package inputs; do not copy unchanged algorithms or assume the legacy original_pins/native_proof package projection supports source-target bindings.
4. Obtain distinct substantive review of the actual final head, required source/geometry/release domains and declared manifest, then use normal serialized integration. Each partial delivery references this focused child. Close this child only when this complete session's acceptance is satisfied; held outcomes remain explicit and this child never closes the parent objective or certifies regional approval, historical import or publication.

Baseline at start: f7c358326d776398bc1cffe84df81eac7033091c. The issue pins actual baseline files; current remaining counts and delivered cells must be measured against each delivery's actual accepted selection. Frozen candidate counts are not current remaining counts or delivered repairs. Shared source-crosswalk changes and cumulative integration require coordination with affected owners.

Initial current accounting at accepted f7c358326d776398bc1cffe84df81eac7033091c: repair evaluation: 190,849 frozen candidates minus 2,794 already-owned cells = 188,055 unassigned; physical interpretation: 133,846 unassigned; source conflict: 27 unassigned. Already accepted overlap is 704 Kolaka cells and 2,090 Sumbawa cells, not new delivery credit. No new cells are qualified or delivered by this issue creation.

The shared selector and package-input paths may be changed only after root assigns the single repository integration lane; source-qualified proposal preparation remains isolated. No production deployment is included.
